media:group.media:title: Lama - Lama - Bernadya | 22nd TIMM YouTube Music Nights Presents ASIA DAY2025-11-06
media:group.media:description:
We bring you the performances from "YouTube Music Nights Presents ASIA DAY", which marked the finale of the showcase live events held over three days at the 22nd Tokyo International Music Market (22nd TIMM).
A total of 7 artists from across Asia participated in this performance: Bernadya, Celine Wanyi, KAKI ACRYLIC, KISS OF LIFE, Regina Song, Rol3ert, and WOLF HOWL HARMONY from EXILE TRIBE.
■ Tokyo International Music Market (TIMM) Official Site: https://www.timmjp.com/ #TIMM #YouTubeMusicNights
